title: Azusawa Kohane — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
So this is the place you wanted to visit, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh... This foot bath's got a real amazing view of the water.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mhm! A guidebook I read featured it as a spot with great views, so it really stuck in my mind!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the weather is nice today, so I had a feeling the water would look beautiful... That's why I wanted to come here no matter what.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're right, the water looks so dazzling and beautiful!
The view's great, and my feet are nice and warm... Now this is what I call paradise♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I figured it'd be two birds with one stone... I get to see this amazing view with all of you, and we get to reenergize after that event too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess this might be just what we need on a day like today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed. I haven't really made use of a foot bath in the past, but it feels particularly pleasant after an event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
For sure! Actually, it kinda feels like we just came here on a normal trip now...
Chilling out like this once in a while isn't so bad, huh!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry, that took a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Dad! Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Welcome back!
Where did you go?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I went over to the Chinatown for a bit, but it sure does get crowded this time of day on everyone's day off.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Actually, An asked me to go buy these.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, sesame balls!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're your favorite, so I was looking around to see if there might be anywhere that sold them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's when Dad offered to go buy some on the down-low.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see, so that's why you went off on your own.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Exactly. Here, I've got enough for all of you.
I got them fresh, so be careful not to burn yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry to have you do this, I know you're tired too.
We appreciate it. Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mm... My body's warm, the water is beautiful, and I even get to have my favorite food... Is it okay to unwind this much?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course it is!
Happy birthday, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Toya & Ken
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone...!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sightseeing around Yokohama sure was fun...
Thank you so much for today!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I'm just glad you all had the chance to take a breather.
Alright, we're here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
This is Miyamasuzaka...
Aren't we going back to Weekend Garage?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Actually, there's somewhere I wanna take you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're taking me somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be heading back first.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, we're not all going?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We just heard about it as well, but this next bit is all Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Have fun, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh... S-Sure thing...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright then, shall we?!
I'll leave our destination as a surprise for when we get there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Wait... This is—

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: We're heeere!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, Kohane!
Welcome to your surprise party!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori...!
And so many other people too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing her for us, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
So, here's your delivery of one Kohane!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?! You're going back too, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Today's your birthday, so I figured it'd be kinda unfair of us to hog you all to ourselves.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, enjoy this time with your pals from Miya Girls!
We'll see you again later, you know the place!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, I heard that An helped out quite a bit with the planning for this surprise.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Originally, I was thinking we probably couldn't celebrate with you today since I heard you'd be out practicing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But then An got in touch to ask if I was planning anything and if I could plan it for the day of. So we planned this together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So that's how it went...
I had no idea she was doing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way I see it, that's just how much she wanted you to enjoy the surprise. That's a partnership for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, Kohane, come this way.
We all helped out to decorate the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
The place looks amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We went all out with our preparations.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We sure did! I asked my manager and got permission to use this place after closing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's not much, but we have some dishes prepared as well.
Please have some if you're hungry.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (To think they'd set up a surprise for me like this... That makes me really happy.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I went sightseeing with everyone in Vivid BAD SQUAD, got a surprise from my school friends... This day has turned out to be a pretty special one.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm gonna relax to my heart's content for today, and then get back to working hard tomorrow!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
I was happy to see you enjoying the mini cakes I made with Minori and Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe, I was too.
You must have practiced hard today. I admire your daily efforts, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
Shiho actually helped me pick out that towel I gave you! I hope you'll get lots of use out of it at different live houses!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kohane. When I heard you've been taking part in all kinds of events and singing off against some amazing people, it hit me just how cool you are. I'll always be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
I hope I get to hear you sing another cool song sometime. Your practices always seem tough, but I'm rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
So, I decided to try my hand at making peach buns this time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You can see the Momoi seal branded right on the...
Actually, it'll be more fun to look for yourself♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
Haruka and I picked out some things that might help with taking care of your feet. I hope you'll give them a try next time you take a bath.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're cheering you on too, Kohane... We hope you'll get to rejuvenate yourself a bit and then keep moving closer to your dream. I wish you and your team the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
We had a fun time with that photo contest, didn't we? I'm rooting for you to achieve that big dream of yours, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday! I hear so much about you from An, so I can confidently say I'm a Kohane expert by now! Let's invite An along to go get sweets or something one of these days♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Azusawa!
I believe you'll be receiving a DVD from Emu in the near future! It's a recording of one of our shows... Please do accept it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think we put on a show that you'll appreciate... So I hope it'll be an enjoyable breather when you watch it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Azusawa.
It feels rather nostalgic to look back on all the times you watched our shows so intently at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've employed some tricks in this production, so that you can once again feel as though you're taking part in our show. Come, won't you join us on a grand adventure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We'll be waiting for you on our biiig brave adventure!
Anyway... Kohane! One more time, happy happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kohane!
Getting to go sightseeing with you in Yokohama was great! I'm glad I took a chance on asking my dad for permission!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd talked to him about it... Well, it did mean we got some good rest in.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It was a very relaxing outing thanks to all of Azusawa's suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Once again, happy birthday.
Let's get back to doing our best tomorrow, so that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll get refocused and go all out as usual.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel like nothing's impossible as long as we're together, Kohane. No matter how far, let's make it there. All this to say... I'll be counting on you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It makes me really happy to know that An put in so much thought for my special day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have An by my side, and Shinonome and Aoyagi too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Just remembering that makes me feel like I can go way above my limits!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's why I'll keep singing my hardest.
Because I want to surpass RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I hope you'll keep watching over me until that moment comes.
Thanks so much for today! Um... See you later.
